messages:
maya: Heads-up from support: customers sending large mixed-dimension embedding batches are getting blunt 413s with no remediation hints. SDKs just surface the error and users DM support. Can we give clients better guidance?
aj: We could return an advisory header on 413/400 that suggests a split plan + rough cost. Something like: `X-Embed-Advisory: dims=768,bytes=234567,units_est=5,split=4x192`. Keep it advisory (non-enforced) and opt-in for Dedicated tenants.

kevin: Strong +1 for advisory header, but Dedicated requires strict controls. Make it tenant opt-in via admin toggle and never include precise tenant quota or billing links. The header should only include estimates.

maya: We also need telemetry: currently we only track 413s. Add `embed.advisory_sent` and `embed.advisory_accepted`. That way product can measure SDK uptake and we can monitor ops impact.

sara: Rollout suggestion: start hosted canary at 5% traffic emitting advisories, tag metrics with rollout=canary, add a dashboard card under Embeddings showing advisory_sent vs accepted, and escalate adoption if accepted < 10% after 2 weeks. SDKs should expose a flag `auto_chunk_advisory=true`.

tom: Operational risk: client auto-chunking can multiply request count and change ingress patterns. Header should include `units_est` and `estimated_split_requests` so SDKs can gate auto-chunking. Also runtime should expose `estimated_split_latency_ms` so SDKs know whether to run parallel or sequential splits.
aj: Proposed header payload: `Embed-Advisory: dims=768,bytes=234567,units=5,split=4x192,split_latency_est_ms=140` Example response: ```HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Embed-Advisory: dims=768,bytes=234567,units_est=5,split=4x192,split_latency_est_ms=140
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"payload too large"}```

kevin: For Dedicated, require explicit admin opt-in and show an audit entry. Also make sure advisory headers are suppressed when tenant policy forbids it. Add unit tests for that.

maya: Console-side: add metrics names `embed.advisory.sent`, `embed.advisory.accepted`, `embed.splitter.calls`, `embed.splitter.p95_ms`. Tag by tenant, route, and rollout_phase. Add a tiny support blurb in the Agents panel: "If you see Payload Too Large, try splitting into N vectors of size M or enable SDK auto-chunking."

sara: I'll create CON dashboard ticket and set two alerts: 1) adoption alert: if advisory_sent/embed.requests > 5% and advisory_accepted < 10% for 7d -> PM reach out; 2) ops alert: if splitter.calls spikes > 4x baseline -> investigate autoscale/backpressure.

tom: SDKs should default to NOT auto-chunking. Show a developer-visible warning; auto-chunk only if `auto_chunk_advisory=true` AND `total_estimated_units_after_split <= original_units * 1.15` to avoid billing surprises.
aj: Action items (I'll take): 1) add advisory header to hosted runtime behind canary flag, 2) emit `embed.advisory.sent` metric, 3) include units_est and split_latency_est_ms in header, 4) add server-side toggle per-tenant.

kevin: I'll gate Dedicated behavior behind a tenant admin flag and log changes. Also ensure no PII or billing numbers leak in headers.
\mama: (typo fix) maya: small request - make header key stable (`X-Embed-Advisory`) and version it if we ever change shape.

console-bot: Created ticket PLAT-EMBED-5810 "Embed advisory headers + SDK adaptive chunking canary". Linked: CON-79. Assignees: aj (impl), kevin (review), sara (rollout).

ops-bot: Watchlist note: splitter will generate more internal requests. Watch `ingest.queue_depth`, `ingest.e2e_latency_ms`, `ingest.shed_rate` during canary.

sara: Scheduling canary: 5% hosted for 7 days, monitor the two alerts, then scale to 25% if stable. SDK teams notified of opt-in flag.

aj: Will open PR with header details and unit tests today. Please review quickly.

kevin: SGTM. Add integration tests verifying header absent when tenant opt-out.

sara: I'll wire dashboard tiles and the alerts. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team 12; I'll follow up with support KB copy after canary. Closing thread.
